title: Varicose Veins: Symptoms, Causes, Warning Signs and Treatment Options in India
seoTitle: Varicose Veins: Symptoms, Causes and When to Worry
seoDescription: Varicose veins are swollen leg veins caused by weak valves. Know the symptoms, causes, who is at risk in India, urgent warning signs and treatment options.
excerpt: Why standing jobs like policing and security raise the risk, the warning signs that need a doctor or an emergency room, and why guidelines now favour ablation over compression stockings.
